per_question.question: A trading company's account keeps receiving large incoming wires that are broken up and pushed out the same day to accounts with no obvious commercial link, so the balance sits near zero overnight. Which trade-based laundering indicator does that pattern correspond to?

Which of the foundational TBML techniques identified in the 2006 FATF report does NOT depend on misrepresenting the price of the goods, and how do criminals use several financial institutions to keep it from being spotted?
Apart from checking price and quantity discrepancies, what practical checks on the paperwork a bank receives to pay a trade transaction have actually helped identify TBML?
When does a customer's use of a virtual asset ATM or kiosk actually amount to a red flag, and when is it not enough on its own?

When a crypto exchange sends a customer's coins to another regulated exchange, which details about the sending customer must the exchange itself have verified, and which details about the receiving party can it pass on without verifying?

A money-remittance business banks with us and runs everything through a single account - its own operating costs and the payments it pushes through for the people who use its service. Should we make it split those flows into separate accounts, and are we obliged to identify its end users ourselves?
What factors influence the commission rate a professional money launderer charges a criminal client, and in what forms do PMLs actually take that commission?

A buyer asks our agency to hold a large deposit in our client account and then wants it refunded to a different bank account than the one it came from. The same property was also resold twice within a few months with price changes nobody can explain. Are both of these treated as high-risk indicators in property transactions?
How can an online shopping platform be used to shift value from one member of a terrorist cell to another abroad, when no bank transfer ever passes between the two of them?
What signs in a trade finance file suggest the two counterparties to the deal are not genuinely independent of one another?
On a life insurance policy, which premium payment patterns and which beneficiary changes should prompt a closer look?

Where a firm uses an unattended remote customer onboarding solution in which the customer does not interact with an employee, what must the verification process include, and what should happen if the evidence captured is of insufficient quality?
Which virtual IBAN (vIBAN) arrangements do EU competent authorities rate as very significant risk, and what mitigating measure does the AML Regulation introduce for the lack of vIBAN transparency?

A corporate client with no prior history of buying digital currency contacts us in a hurry to purchase a large amount of Bitcoin, and in conversation shows they barely understand how it works. What does FinCEN say that combination is likely to mean?

A day-spa business account we monitor takes in nearly all of its money as cash, with most deposits posting late at night and far exceeding what a single storefront should earn, and it never sends any payroll or ACH payments. The listed phone number also appears on escort advertising sites. Which specific indicators does this combination match?

What shell company red flags should a depository institution look for when the registration data on a business customer does not line up with its stated business - specifically around NAICS codes, addresses, name variations, and EINs?

A Mexican importer client is wiring money to a Chinese chemical manufacturer, and the payment instructions and supporting invoice identify the substance only by a numeric registry identifier rather than naming it. Why do BSA filers treat that as an indicator of illicit precursor procurement?
Why is a money order seller usually unable to screen the payee's name, and at what currency amount is it actually required to obtain and verify the purchaser's identity?

A new wealth management client wants to open an account funded by a very large cash deposit plus a payment arriving from a casino. At what point do we need independent evidence about where that money came from instead of accepting the client's own explanation?
When assessing whether a media source is credible enough to rely on for negative news screening, what characteristics indicate a reputable source and what indicators suggest a source is not reliable?

A respondent bank sends us bundles of physical cheques to clear through the account it holds with us. What patterns on those cheque items should make an analyst suspicious, and why is this activity hard to monitor?
In trade finance, how do over invoicing, under invoicing and short shipping each transfer excess value, and which party to the trade gains in each case?

When a UK organised crime group hands its cash takings to an informal banking network that supplies funds to a diaspora community whose home country caps how much money residents may send overseas each year, what does the crime group get back in exchange, and why is that network so hungry for physical cash in the UK?
In MTIC carousel fraud, what does a contra-trading scheme add on top of the basic carousel, and which commodity is identified as an emerging one in VAT fraud schemes?

Our screening only compares customer names against the UK sanctions list and it never produces a hit. What does the FCA say that approach can miss, what detection technique does it point firms towards, and where can we get warning indicators for that behaviour?

A bank we clear payments for keeps sending us instructions where the payer field holds filler text instead of a real name. What are we as the intermediary supposed to do when we spot that, and who ultimately has to make sure the payer's details are accurate?

We have a group buying several high-value cars with cash and putting the registrations in the names of people outside the group, while the same principals run a number of used-jewellery outlets. What scheme does that combination point to?
What red flags turned up in the bank accounts of persons of interest connected to a Philippine offshore gaming operator that was actually running scam operations?

A vendor tool we use to flag senior public officials among our customer base returns an unmanageable number of irrelevant name hits. What is the underlying reason these tools generate so much noise, why can't the vendors simply resolve it, and what goes wrong if we tighten the match settings to bring the hit volume down?

Our relationship managers and compliance officers keep deadlocking over whether to take on high-risk corporate clients, and when the decision is escalated the revenue side usually prevails. How should that escalation body be structured so commercial interests cannot carry the decision?

In the FCA's enforcement action over the Russian "mirror trading" scheme, what financial penalty was imposed on Deutsche Bank, and what specific AML systems and controls failings did the Final Notice identify?
What was the total value of the October 2024 US resolution with TD Bank over its BSA/AML program failures, and how much of that was FinCEN's civil money penalty?
How much was Westpac ordered to pay in the AUSTRAC civil penalty proceedings over its failure to report international funds transfer instructions, and how many contraventions did it admit to?

The FATF real estate guidance cites FINTRAC's operational brief on money laundering indicators in real estate transactions. For a Canadian real estate brokerage that is a reporting entity under the PCMLTFA, what is the CAD threshold that triggers a Large Cash Transaction Report, how does the 24-hour aggregation rule apply to multiple smaller cash receipts, and what is the deadline for submitting a suspicious transaction report to FINTRAC once suspicion is reached?

The UNODC casino report describes AUSTRAC's enforcement action and the AUD 450 million penalty agreed with Crown over junket-related breaches. Under Australia's AML/CTF Act 2006, what is the AUD threshold above which a reporting entity must lodge a Threshold Transaction Report, and within how many days must a Suspicious Matter Report be lodged - does that deadline shorten where the suspicion relates to terrorism financing?

The UNODC report notes that a 2023 AMLC study into casino junkets found operators repeatedly failing to report covered transactions. What is the peso threshold above which a Philippine casino must file a covered transaction report under RA 10927, and how many working days does it have to submit that report to the AMLC?

Our blockchain analytics vendor still flags the Tornado Cash smart contract addresses as sanctioned. Are those addresses currently designated on OFAC's SDN List, or have they been removed — and if they were delisted, on what basis?

For our country risk model refresh, which jurisdictions are currently on the FATF list of Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring, and which countries were removed from that list at the most recent plenary?

We are re-papering a correspondent relationship that touches Binance. Is the independent compliance monitor imposed under the 2023 US resolutions still in place, or has that monitorship been ended, and what is the exchange's current remediation status?

We're running a vendor selection for a new transaction monitoring and sanctions screening platform for our correspondent banking book. How do NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM and Napier compare on false positive rates and detection coverage, and which of them do the Wolfsberg CBDDQ guidance or the FCA treat as meeting the expected standard?
